about: A line over time on two axes that draws itself point by point as the years or steps are said: a quantity growing, falling or levelling off, optionally beside a second line.

values.about: the numbers in order, one per point

labels.about: what each point is (years, steps), split by |

unit.about: written after numbers, such as % or bn

name.about: what the line is, written at the top

second.about: a second line's numbers, to compare against

when.about: moments the line reaches each point, such as @2,@5,@9; else when each label is said, or spread out

secondWhen.about: moments for the second line's points
